**Additional considerations:**
- Some robots may never see the green wall directly, so we might want a probabilistic fallback
- We could also use attraction to bring robots toward green-seeing robots
- 3-state: Explore → GoToColor(green) → Stop, using green perception

- S0: Explore (moving), LED=off
- S1: Stop, LED=yellow (cle=4) → stopped robots glow yellow
- S0→S1 on C=7(green) OR C=7(yellow) with high prob

This way, stopped robots signal others to also stop! This is a cascade/contagion mechanism.

- S0: Explore, LED=off → transition to S1 on seeing green wall, or to S1 on seeing yellow robots
- S1: Stop, LED=yellow → stays stopped (very rare return to explore)
